# Producer Consumer Pattern

READ THE WHOLE THING FROM HERE [ProducerConsumer.pdf](Producer%20Consumer%20Pattern/ProducerConsumer.pdf)

- Text for searchability:
    
    We have
    
    - 1 or more producers, that produce items to storage
    - 1 or more consumers, that consume these items from storage
    
    Example of use: You're pushing to an API that has an upper ratelimit. You'll have to wait for a 200 response from the last push before you push the next one (CM pushing data to FDP via Dart)
    
    [](data:image/png;base64,)
    
    - If there's no items in storage, consumer waits until producer has produced
    - If there's no space in storage, producer waits until consumer has consumed
    
    ## USE A BLOCKING QUEUE
    
    BlockingQueue is constructed with a specified maximum size
    
    ### Methods to enqueue
    
    1. queue.put(element): Blocks thread until there's space in queue for element. Throws InterruptedException if the thread that is waiting to enqueue gets interrupted
    2. queue.add(element): Will not block is there's no space, throws an IllegalStateExcpetion instead
    3. queue.offer(element): Doesn't block, returns true or false (bool) if there wasn't space for the element
    4. queue.offer(element, timeout): Doesn't block forever, only till the timeout. Also throws InterruptedException
    
    ### Methods to dequeue
    
    1. queue.take(): Blocks until element becomes available. Also throws InterruptedException if thread is interrupted.
    2. queue.poll(): Return first element in the queue. Returns null if there's no element.
    3. queue.poll(timeout): Waits for specified timeout for element to appear in queue. Throws InterruptedException.
    4. queue.remove(element): Removes element if element is present in queue. If multiple elements match, it only removes the first el.
    
    To remove all elements from queue to a container
    
    1. queue.drainTo(collection)
    2. queue.drainTo(collection, number of elements)
    
    [](data:image/png;base64,)
    
    ### DOING THIS WITHOUT BLOCKING QUEUE
    
    We have to ways to do this
    
    1. Using Locks and Conditions
    2. Using Wait-Notify
